title: The North Face Transgrancanaria — World Trail Majors activity page
claims: World Trail Majors lists The North Face Transgrancanaria as a WTM Classic race of 126 km with +6,764 m, and the Marathon as a 47 km Short Series race with +1,784 m.
The WTM page gives the first edition as 2003 and describes Transgrancanaria as the first ultra race in Spain.
The WTM page records about 3,500 total participants and the 2027 race dates as 2027/02/22-28, located in Maspalomas, Gran Canaria.
The WTM page lists notable previous winners including Pau Capell, Sebastian Chaigneau, Caroline Chaverot, Courtney Dauwalter, Ryan Sandes and Andreu Simon, among others.
